visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video presents a static, vertical nighttime shot of the Taipei 101 skyscraper. A vibrant light projection on the building's facade features a cartoon bear character (OhBear) against a bright blue background. At the top of the frame, Traditional Chinese text is superimposed. The base of the building shows faint city lights and silhouettes of trees against the dark night sky. (2) The light show transitions through several animated phases, showing lush green hills, blue skies, and various Taiwanese scenic landscapes. The lighting is high-contrast and colorful, with the building's architectural details visible under the glowing projections. (3) The animation sequence continues, displaying stylized icons of Taiwanese culture and food, such as a cup of pearl milk tea. The camera remains fixed, capturing the smooth transitions of the light display on the tower. (4) The sequence concludes with a bright red and white projection spelling out 'TAIWAN' on the upper section of the building, surrounded by decorative light patterns.
